messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Study 1 was a 72-week trial comparing Zepbound weight loss with placebo in adults with obesity or overweight with at least one weight-related condition, excluding patients with type 2 diabetes.
Zepbound Weight Loss Results at 72 Weeks by Dose:
Treatment dose | Average % weight loss | Average weight lost | Average starting weight

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'does not reduce risk of': The subject drug does not lower the risk of the medical condition or event specified by the object entity.

D. 'has not been studied in': The subject drug has not been evaluated or tested in the patient population or condition specified by the object entity.
